outputs.headline: True: India first to land on Moon's south pole
outputs.summary: India's Chandrayaan-3 mission was the first to successfully land a spacecraft in the Moon's south pole region on August 23, 2023.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that India's Moon mission made history by being the first to land in the lunar south pole region.
outputs.what_is_true: India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed a spacecraft near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, making it the first country to achieve this.
evidence_for: NASA Science confirmed that Chandrayaan-3 landed near the south pole of the Moon on August 23, 2023.
The Guardian reported that India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon on August 23, 2023.
PBS stated that India was the first country to touch down near the little-explored south pole region on August 23.
outputs.sources_spoken: NASA Science, The Guardian, and PBS
outputs.audio_script: The post claims that India's Moon mission made history by being the first to land in the lunar south pole region. This is true. India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed a spacecraft near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, making it the first country to achieve this. We are very sure of this information. This comes from reliable sources like NASA Science, The Guardian, and PBS, all of whom confirmed the historic landing.
card_lines: TRUE: India first to land on Moon's south pole
India's Chandrayaan-3 mission landed on August 23, 2023.
It was the first country to land near the lunar south pole.
Confirmed by NASA Science and The Guardian.

outputs.headline: True: Chandrayaan-3 lander touched down on time
outputs.summary: The claim that the Vikram lander from Chandrayaan-3 successfully touched down at 18:04 local time on August 23, 2023, is true.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that the Vikram lander from Chandrayaan-3 successfully touched down at 18:04 local time (12:34 GMT) on August 23, 2023.
outputs.what_is_true: The Vikram lander from India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully touched down on the Moon on August 23, 2023, at approximately 6:04 PM Indian Standard Time, which is 12:34 PM GMT.
evidence_for: NDTV reported that ISRO announced the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft was set to land on the Moon on August 23, 2023, around 6:04 PM IST.
The Guardian reported that the Vikram lander touched down shortly after 6 PM (12:30 PM BST) on August 23.
Space.com stated that the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft was scheduled to touch down around 6:04 PM Indian Standard Time on Wednesday, August 23.
outputs.audio_script: A post claims that the Vikram lander from Chandrayaan-3 successfully touched down at 6:04 PM local time on August 23, 2023. This is true. The Vikram lander from India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully touched down on the Moon on August 23, 2023, at approximately 6:04 PM Indian Standard Time, which is 12:34 PM GMT. We are very sure about this information. This comes from reports by NDTV, The Guardian, and Space.com, all confirming the successful landing and the time.
card_lines: True: Chandrayaan-3 lander touched down on time
The post claims the Vikram lander landed at 6:04 PM local time on August 23.
This is true. The lander touched down at 6:04 PM IST on August 23, 2023.

outputs.headline: Unconfirmed: India joins elite club of moon landing nations
outputs.summary: We could not confirm if India joined an elite club of countries to achieve a soft landing on the Moon, after the US, the former Soviet Union and China.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that India joined an elite club of countries to achieve a soft landing on the Moon, after the US, the former Soviet Union and China.
outputs.what_is_true: With its successful Chandrayaan-3 mission on August 23, 2023, India became the fourth country to achieve a soft landing on the Moon, after the United States, the former Soviet Union, and China.
evidence_for: The Business Standard reported that India became the fourth country in the world to perform a soft landing on the moon on August 23, 2023, joining Russia, the United States, and China.
Wikipedia states that with this landing, ISRO became the fourth national space agency to successfully land on the Moon, after the Soviet space program, NASA, and CNSA.
PBS reported that India joined the United States, the Soviet Union, and China in achieving a moon landing on August 23.
outputs.sources_spoken: according to The Business Standard, Wikipedia, and PBS
